findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding the preceding sentences, this Subsection will not limit the liability of a Party for any amount or type of damages for: (1) the defense and indemnification of an Indemnified Claim on which the Party is the Indemnifying Party; (2) infringement by the Party on the intellectual property of the other Party; (3) the unauthorized disclosure or use by the Party of the Confidential Information of the other Party; (4) payment or reimbursement of any amount expressly required to be paid or reimbursed by the Party under a provision of this Agreement; or (5) the intentional misconduct of the Party in violation of Applicable Laws.

findings.explanation: This clause carves out major categories of liability—such as indemnification claims, IP infringement, and confidentiality breaches—from the general limitation on direct damages, leaving your financial liability completely uncapped and exposing you to catastrophic losses.
findings.suggested_change: Propose a reasonable aggregate liability cap (e.g., total fees received under the relevant Purchase Schedule over the past 12 months) that applies to all claims, including indemnification, or cap indemnification at the limits of the required insurance coverage.

findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, a Party may suspend performance or terminate this Agreement or any accepted purchase order for a product being purchase and sold under this Agreement immediately on written notice to the other Party, and without providing the other Party an opportunity to cure the material breach... for a material breach by the other Party involving substantial harm to the reputation, goodwill and business of the non-breaching Party that cannot reasonably be avoided or fully redressed by providing the other Party an opportunity to cure the material breach.
findings.explanation: The buyer can immediately terminate the agreement and cancel purchase orders without any notice or opportunity to cure if they allege 'substantial harm to reputation, goodwill and business,' which is highly subjective and leaves you vulnerable to abrupt contract cancellation.
findings.suggested_change: Remove the immediate termination exception for reputation and goodwill, and ensure that all alleged material breaches are subject to a standard 30-day written notice and cure period.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a small adjustment before signing:

- Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms leave financial liability uncapped for major categories such as indemnification and confidentiality breaches, so I propose introducing a reasonable aggregate liability cap to ensure balanced terms for both parties.

Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.
